title: From Pastor to Atheist: Fatherhood Made Me Deconvert

top_liked.text: I was a pastor's wife of 20 years. I also had 4 emergency c-sections. Ultimately it was learning about the numerous errors and inconsistencies that became impossible to ignore. Upon learning who invented christianity and piece--milled its "holy" book, I was officially done!
